protocol.growth_tasks: Three visible-input formatter attempts and three visible-input CSV-parent-to-hashing attempts per model. Fresh public input bytes per repeat, identical within each model pair.
protocol.admission: One benchmark and >=4/5 ordinary tasks; one advisory app diagnostic per arm, never success-selected repeated
protocol.overlap: Formatter family and ordinary tasks are training-exposed. CSV parent/task format is absent from training; hashing calls are familiar. Unicode validation remains historical.
protocol.scope: 12 directed second-extension attempts from human-supplied independently checked parents. No autonomous first-upgrade or unseen hashing capability claim. No seed/prompt treatment changes.

configuration.loss: Only supervised target positions; full untruncated context retained
configuration.allocator_policy: Release unused cache after every update; include cost in step timing; preserve peak statistics
configuration.adapter_scope: All 32 text decoder layers; same projection types, rank 8
configuration.schedule: Linear warmup for ten updates, then linear decay to 10% of peak at update 423
configuration.attention_kernel: PyTorch EFFICIENT_ATTENTION only; Flash, cudnn and math fallback disabled; explicit KV repetition for GQA

checkpoint_offload.offload: checkpoint saved inputs to pinned CPU RAM

training.selection_scope: Reused historical Unicode validation; not independent workflow or generalization evidence.
training.readiness: Five full-model readiness attempts: four failed, fifth completed two updates. Missing-import launch failure occurred before those. All retained separately.

limitations: Three repeats per arm/family; exploratory results, no reliability guarantee.
Formatter workflows and the hashing API are training-exposed. CSV parent/task format is absent from training; this is transfer, not a novel hashing API.
Both parents were supplied and independently checked; no autonomous first-upgrade credit.
43 workflow decisions came from seven related successful formatter workflows sharing one prescribed lineage. Only one source workflow used visible final inputs.
Historical Unicode validation and ordinary tasks overlap previous preparation; they are not independent final benchmarks.
Training used explicit context reduction, efficient SDPA and CPU checkpoint-input offloading; improvement cannot be attributed to one dataset detail alone.
One training watchdog interruption and one stale-heartbeat resume launch failure; completed five updates were discarded and replayed from update 375.
Four failed full-model readiness checks preceded the successful fifth; a missing-import preparation launch and a missing-import export launcher also failed before inference.
Official frozen scores remain authoritative; extra AST-based route observations are diagnostics only.
Published Q6 metadata does not prove byte-identical upstream HF ancestry. Runtime adapter effect and control restoration were verified.
Known token sums include cached prefixes and are not financial cost. Measurement completeness is tracked separately.
No permanent seed activation, application/default change, model merge, commit or push.
